about_the_game:
Tiny Vending Machine is an idle pixel art game designed to run at the bottom of your screen while you focus on other tasks. Your goal is to build and expand your vending machine empire, keeping them stocked and maximizing profits.

How does it work?

Buy and manage vending machines that sell various products, including drinks, candy, ice cream, fruits, fast food, salads, soups, and more.

Random customers will appear to purchase items – make sure your machines stay stocked to avoid missing sales.

Upgrade your machines to increase storage capacity. At the highest level, they become fully automated.

Observe foot traffic and adjust pricing in real-time to match customer behavior and maximize your earnings.

Explore different city locations to place your vending machines in areas with higher demand and unique customer profiles.

Dynamically adjust item prices based on demand, balancing affordability and profit to stay ahead of the competition.

Customize your machines with different colors to make your vending empire unique.

Play without interrupting your routine!
Tiny Vending Machine runs in the background, allowing you to manage your machines while working, studying, or relaxing.

Expand your business and become the ultimate vending machine tycoon!

__________________

🎮 Twitch Integration Tiny Vending Machines offers a unique and interactive Twitch integration between streamers and their followers! Viewers show up as in-game customers, purchasing items from your vending machines in real time—directly influencing your gameplay and helping grow your vending empire. It’s easy to set up, fun to play, and perfect for building stronger engagement with your community!
